description: "A monitor parity checking (platformio.ini option monitor_parity)."

# `monitor_parity`

- **Type:** String: `N`, `E`, `O`, `S`, `M`
- **Multiple values:** No
- **Default:** `N`

Enable parity checking. See [`pio device monitor --parity`](../../cli/pio-device/monitor.md#cmdoption-pio-device-monitor-parity) for the available values.
